Name: WorkBuddy
Overview: Launch WorkBuddy, draft tasks, choose models and see live task status.
Description:
Control WorkBuddy from your Ulanzi device.
Actions:
- New Task: open a task with a prefilled draft. Supports prompt templates with {clipboard}, {date} and {time} placeholders, plus working directory, expert, skills, connectors, model, mode and permission settings. WorkBuddy keeps the draft unsent until you confirm.
- Open Page: jump to tasks, projects, experts, skills, connectors, automation, Agent Mail and more.
- Model Switch (encoder): turn the dial to switch the model in the task composer.
Setup:
1. Install the WorkBuddy desktop client (workbuddy:// scheme).
2. Drag an action onto a key or the knob.
3. Pick the scheme in the property inspector: workbuddy:// for the domestic package, workbuddy-ai:// for WorkBuddy AI.
Notes: task prompts are limited to 8000 characters; skill and connector lists accept up to 20 comma-separated items
Launch WorkBuddy with CDP to use Voice Input, Send Message, Current Session Status and Switch Theme. Each action includes CDP setup.
